name: bugzilla
description: Search, triage and comment on Firefox/Mozilla bugs from Claude via the Bugzilla REST API.

setup.instructions: Read-only access needs no credentials. For write access (filing bugs, commenting, tagging, updating), get an API key from your Bugzilla API Keys preferences page (https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/userprefs.cgi?tab=apikey) and set MCP_BUGZILLA_API_KEY. Set MCP_BUGZILLA_BASE_URL only if you're pointing at a self-hosted Bugzilla instance instead of bugzilla.mozilla.org.
